questions.prompt: A student is answering an AQA-style practice question. Explain how a transformer changes an alternating potential difference. (4)
hints: Transformers require alternating current.
Compare turns ratio with potential-difference ratio.
questions.solution:
An alternating current in the primary coil produces a changing magnetic field in the iron core. [B1]
The changing magnetic field links the secondary coil and induces an alternating potential difference. [B1]
The ratio of secondary to primary potential difference equals the ratio of secondary to primary turns for an ideal transformer. [B1]
More turns on the secondary gives a step-up transformer; fewer gives a step-down transformer. [B1]
